name: Mensuration
overview: A right circular cylinder has base radius 14cm and height 21cm. It is melted and recast into a solid cylinder of diameter 14 cm. A container shaped a right circular cylinder having diameter 12 cm and height 15 cm is full of ice cream.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: A right circular _____ has base radius 14cm and height 21cm.
vsaq.answer: A right circular cylinder has base radius 14cm and height 21cm.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The liquid is to be filled into cylindrical bottles of _____ 5 cm and height 6 cm.
vsaq.answer: The liquid is to be filled into cylindrical bottles of diameter 5 cm and height 6 cm.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: This liquid is to be filled in cylindrical bottles of radius 3 cm. and _____ 6 cm.
vsaq.answer: This liquid is to be filled in cylindrical bottles of radius 3 cm. and height 6 cm.

vsaq.answer: A solid in the form of right circular cone mounted on a hemisphere is 3 cm.

vsaq.answer: A hemispherical bowl of internal radius 15 cm contains a liquid.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The top is shaped like a cone surmounted by a _____.
vsaq.answer: The top is shaped like a cone surmounted by a hemisphere.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: This is filled by pumping _____ from a sump (an under ground tank) which is in the shape of a cuboid.
vsaq.answer: This is filled by pumping water from a sump (an under ground tank) which is in the shape of a cuboid.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: You have learnt how to find the surface area and _____ of single regular solids only like a football.
vsaq.answer: You have learnt how to find the surface area and volume of single regular solids only like a football.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: A pen stand is made of wood in the shape of cuboid with three _____ depressions to hold the pens.
vsaq.answer: A pen stand is made of wood in the shape of cuboid with three conical depressions to hold the pens.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Hence, the number of _____ wax candles that can be prepared is 1500.
vsaq.answer: Hence, the number of cylindrical wax candles that can be prepared is 1500.
